notes.title: Update Incoming!
notes.content:
Hello fellow heroes!

On the suggestion of an awesome fan, I'm writing you a quick announcement to let you all know that we're not dead! More awesome content is on the way for HNLPPPP! 

This is a WIP image of Brainfreeze's upcoming stage:

http://imgur.com/a/JLyEM


Here are the finished animations for Miss Direction:

http://imgur.com/a/Txzuz


We have just finished recording her VOs and hopefully she'll be out and about causing mischief as soon as her special and super effects are done!

Thank you for being patient with us, there's yet more to come!

notes.title: Please welcome our newest heroine!
notes.content:
Once you update to version 0.0.1829, you will have access to a new playable character and 5 new achievements. 

[h1]Unlock Gnat-Girl right now![/h1]

Why are you still reading this? Open up Steam, launch the game, and get cracking! To unlock Gnat-Girl, you simply have to beat her! I'll let you figure out how to do that ;)

[h1]New Achievements![/h1]

To celebrate our electrifying insectoid heroine's reveal, we're adding not one, not two, but 5 new Gnat-themed achievements to the game bringing the grand total to a whopping 27!

[list]
[*][b]Gnat born yesterday![/b]	Unlock Gnat-Girl!
[*][b]Gnat to be sneezed at![/b]	Complete Arcade Mode as Gnat-Girl.
[*][b]Shocking Development![/b]	Electrify 100 blocks.
[*][b]Gnat's best friend.[/b]	Challenge a friend online!
[*][b]I would Gnat hurt a fly.[/b]	Answer the age old question, who is the ultimate Gnat?
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.0.1797
notes.content:
- Improved the flexibility of the gem pair movements so it is a lot easier to make them fit in tight spots. (be warned, the AI can now do this too)
- Online ranking scores are now a bit more forgiving. Losing a match shouldn't give you such a big penalty. 
- Optimized the net code. Now it uses much less bandwidth (not that the bandwidth was ever high)
- Fixed a bug that caused online players to have different background stages

notes.title: Version 0.0.1771
notes.content:
- Making sure the game is not reset when Steam has problems updating stats on the server. 
- Fixed rare bug that caused gems to not be cleaned at the end of a round for the winner. 
- Making sure the AI doesn't get stuck when it can't find a path to where it wants to place its gem pair.
- The hardest AI will no longer just let gravity lower his gem pair, it will always fast drop it or push it downwards.
